typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parent.description: The sensor that this summary is for.

interval.description: The interval for which average {@link flatlinePercentage} and {@link missingPercentage} were calculated.

flatlinePercentage.description:
The average percentage of time that the sensor was flatlined during the time range.
By default, a single timestamp is considered "flatlined" if the value has not changed for the prior 6 hours.

missingPercentage.description:
The average percentage of time that the sensor was missing during the time range.
Whether or not a timestamp is missing is determined by {@link Timeseries#missing} on the result of evaluating
the `QuantityRawPointSeries` metric.

Note that with {@link AggOp#PREVIOUS} treatment for timeseries normalization (as is the default), data points
will have their values repeated in subsequent intervals until a new data point appears, as long as a future
data point exists. Those interpolated values are then not considered missing under this calculation.

title:
A cached summary of sensor data statistics for a given time range and interval.

**IMPORTANT: This type should never be populated directly, but rather created as-needed through the {@link createMissing} or
{@link getForSensors} APIs.**

This ensures that several assumptions remain true:
   * Each summary entity represents the same time range (a week)
   * No two summary entities for the same {@link Sensor} and {@link Interval} overlap in time range (this is enforced
     by having each {@link start} be a Sunday midnight)
   * Within a queried time range, all summary entities are present before performing aggregation
name: SensorDataSummary
